owner.name: Layne Singh
owner.public_bio: Founder of Graby (graby.ai) and Minefirst (minefirst.ai): AI that finds and buys underpriced resale fashion on Vinted and eBay. London.

items.title: Public: graby.ai
items.text: Graby is a search engine for resale fashion deals. It ingests Vinted listings, screens them for price and authenticity, and shows the underpriced ones. UK Ltd, with a German version on vinted.de. Paid Pro plan through Stripe.

items.title: Public: minefirst.ai
items.text: Minefirst sends brand, category and price alerts for Vinted and eBay UK, screened by an AI authenticity checker, at 9.99 a month. Live in the UK and Germany (de.minefirst.ai).

items.title: Public: Minefirst Agent
items.text: Building an agent that negotiates and buys on Vinted on the user's behalf: it makes offers, waits for acceptance and checks out, charging a share of the money it saves.

items.title: Hackathon: Nudge Network
items.text: Building Nudge Network with Jasnoor: two people's digital twins negotiate something valuable, and a sealed-intent eval checks the twins actually act like their owners.
